name: skillvault-install
title: SkillVault Install
description: [list|update|uninstall|clean|refresh] Alone: the catalog. Text: install it. Manage installed SkillVault copies and keep them current: install by exact name or a * pattern, list installed copies, update them from the local checkout, uninstall, clean up copies that load twice or conflict, and refresh from upstream. Shorthand: /sv-install. Clean shows overlaps, which skillvault-discover can evaluate; refresh scheduling delegates to harness-schedule. Edits no SkillVault source or application code except refresh's adaptation merges; skillvault-author owns skill authoring.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Menu word: list, update, uninstall, clean, or refresh. Alone, the skill shows the catalog with each skill's state here; other text installs the named skill or * pattern. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: skill
inputs.description: Skill name, matched exactly and ignoring case, or a name pattern with *: name*, *name, *name*, or * for every skill. No exact match installs nothing and suggests skills that mention it. Omit to see the catalog.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Optional second positional target: global (~/.copilot/skills), project (.github/skills), or session (current AI session only). Defaults to the resolved skill's install.defaultScope, then project.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Optional third positional version: latest or a skill version in v#.#.# format, installed from that skill's <skill>/v#.#.# tag. Defaults to latest.

inputs.name: repoPath
inputs.description: Explicit verified source checkout, named in plain words such as from C:\path\skillvault. Otherwise use the known C:\repos\skillvault checkout; never silently select a cache or another session's clone. Separate from the target project.
